en-US.title: Fourpop - Photo Booth
en-US.subtitle: 4-cut strips, anywhere
en-US.description:
Fourpop turns your phone into a photo booth.

Pick a frame, hit start, and the countdown begins. Eight shots, then you choose the best four. Add a filter, stickers, a date stamp — and share your strip to your favorite apps.

LIKE A REAL BOOTH
• The classic 1×4 strip, just like the booth
• Real countdown timer (3, 5 or 10 seconds) with pose hints
• Shoot 8, keep 4
• Front or back camera, mirror selfies
• Or build a strip from photos you already have

MAKE IT YOURS
• 10 frames to start, plus seasonal packs for Tết, Songkran, Valentine's and more
• Filters, stickers, drawing, text and date stamp
• HD export, no watermark
• Animated GIF of all 8 shots
• Everything saved to your Fourpop gallery

Fourpop is free, with no ads and no in-app purchases.
Terms: https://cozynye.github.io/apps/terms.html · Privacy: https://cozynye.github.io/apps/privacy.html
en-US.promoText: The photo booth, in your pocket. Countdown, 8 shots, pick your best 4, add a frame, share in a tap.
en-US.releaseNotes: Fourpop is here — a photo booth in your pocket. Real countdown, 8 shots, keep your best 4, 10 frames, filters, stickers, text and date stamp, HD export without watermark and animated GIFs, then save or share. Free, no ads.

vi.title: Fourpop - Photobooth
vi.subtitle: Chụp 4 tấm, ở bất cứ đâu
vi.description:
Fourpop biến điện thoại của bạn thành một photobooth.

Chọn khung, bấm bắt đầu, đếm ngược chạy. Tám tấm, rồi bạn chọn bốn tấm đẹp nhất. Thêm bộ lọc, sticker, dấu ngày — và chia sẻ dải ảnh tới ứng dụng bạn thích.

NHƯ BOOTH THẬT
• Dải ảnh 1×4 như ở booth thật
• Đếm ngược thật (3, 5 hoặc 10 giây) kèm gợi ý tạo dáng
• Chụp 8, giữ 4
• Camera trước hoặc sau, lật ảnh selfie
• Hoặc ghép dải ảnh từ ảnh có sẵn

THEO CÁCH CỦA BẠN
• 10 khung để bắt đầu, thêm bộ khung theo mùa cho Tết, Valentine, 8/3, 20/10…
• Bộ lọc, sticker, vẽ, chữ và dấu ngày
• Xuất HD, không watermark
• GIF động từ cả 8 tấm
• Tất cả lưu vào bộ sưu tập Fourpop

Fourpop miễn phí, không quảng cáo, không mua trong ứng dụng.
Điều khoản: https://cozynye.github.io/apps/terms.html · Quyền riêng tư: https://cozynye.github.io/apps/privacy.html
vi.promoText: Photobooth trong túi bạn. Đếm ngược, 8 tấm, chọn 4 tấm đẹp nhất, thêm khung, chia sẻ chỉ một chạm.
vi.releaseNotes: Fourpop ra mắt — photobooth trong túi bạn. Đếm ngược thật, 8 tấm, giữ 4 tấm đẹp nhất, 10 khung, bộ lọc, sticker, chữ và dấu ngày, xuất HD không watermark và GIF động, rồi lưu hoặc chia sẻ. Miễn phí, không quảng cáo.

th.title: Fourpop - โฟโต้บูธ
th.subtitle: ถ่าย 4 ช่อง ได้ทุกที่
th.description:
Fourpop เปลี่ยนมือถือของคุณให้เป็นโฟโต้บูธ

เลือกกรอบ กดเริ่ม แล้วนับถอยหลัง ถ่าย 8 ช็อต แล้วเลือก 4 ช็อตที่ชอบที่สุด ใส่ฟิลเตอร์ สติกเกอร์ ตราวันที่ — แล้วแชร์แถบรูปไปยังแอปที่คุณชอบ

เหมือนบูธจริง
• แถบรูป 1×4 เหมือนบูธจริง
• นับถอยหลังจริง (3, 5 หรือ 10 วินาที) พร้อมคำแนะนำท่าโพส
• ถ่าย 8 เก็บ 4
• กล้องหน้าหรือหลัง กลับด้านเซลฟี่ได้
• หรือทำแถบรูปจากรูปที่มีอยู่แล้ว

ทำให้เป็นสไตล์คุณ
• กรอบเริ่มต้น 10 แบบ พร้อมชุดตามเทศกาล สงกรานต์ ลอยกระทง วาเลนไทน์ และอื่น ๆ
• ฟิลเตอร์ สติกเกอร์ วาด ข้อความ และตราวันที่
• ส่งออก HD ไม่มีลายน้ำ
• GIF เคลื่อนไหวจากทั้ง 8 ช็อต
• ทุกอย่างบันทึกในแกลเลอรี Fourpop

Fourpop ใช้ฟรี ไม่มีโฆษณา ไม่มีการซื้อในแอป
